research_scope: Super Afterimage and God Breaker counter-taxonomy/acquisition reconciliation.

findings.name: Super Afterimage
findings.counter_taxonomy: Counter Skills membership retained; current skill page describes counter-like vanish usage but current dedicated subtype list does not assign Super Afterimage to Melee, Ki, or Universal.
findings.conclusion: No correction required. Preserve Counter Skills cross-taxonomy membership without inventing a subtype.

findings.name: God Breaker
findings.acquisition: PQ44 — Dragon Balls of the Future
findings.conclusion: No correction required. Current documentation explicitly lists God Breaker as a Strike Counter and PQ44 acquisition remains supported.

method: Compared current Xenoverse 2 skill pages and Counter Skill taxonomy with repository batches and independent acquisition references. Kept unsupported subtype/UF fields null rather than inferring them.
